metaDescription: Kevin, in a clip from a May 2026 livestream, explains why he rejects the longtermist vision of immortal cyborgs spreading AI through space.
summary: Kevin rejects the longtermist vision of humans becoming immortal cyborgs that spread AI through space, saying he would rather live about 80 years in good health. Clipped from a May 25, 2026 livestream, he describes the seven cults as less important than what the world's richest people openly say they believe. Kevin argues they reveal their goals in pieces, that the technology could kill most people, and that a window remains to halt it.
